notes: Full description: pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs - CrlChecker::check_revocation() calls CertificateList::from_der(&self.crl_der) at line 189, and also at line 271 for the delta CRL. OcspChecker::check_revocation() similarly re-parses at line 93. This means for an N-cert chain every call to check_revocation re-parses the full CRL (and delta CRL). For a 5-cert chain that is 5 full CRL parses + 5 delta CRL parses per validation run. The doc comment at crl.rs:80-83 acknowledges this as a v0.2 tracking item. This is already documented, but should be filed as a finding for tracking. The OcspChecker doc comment at ocsp.rs:39-43 also acknowledges this. File: pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:189 and pkix-revocation/src/ocsp.rs:93. Fix: Cache parsed CertificateList/BasicOcspResponse in new()/with_delta(). Tracked by existing v0.2 notes in doc comments.
title: FINDING: CrlChecker re-parses DER on every call (O(N) for N-cert chain)
